text.p: Close of play scores on the first day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Wednesday:
At Chesterfield: Derbyshire 361-7 (A.Rollins 151 not out, C.Adams 79) v Hampshire.
At Tunbridge Wells: Warwickshire 314 (T.Penney 84; J.Thompson 5-89). Kent 30-0.
At Lord's: Leicestershire 267-7 (J.Whitaker 108 not out; A.Fraser 4-70) v Middlesex.
At Northampton: Northamptonshire 226-9 (D.Ripley 77; M.Bowen 5-52) v Nottinghamshire.
At Taunton: Lancashire 88 (K.Shine 7-43) and 40-1. Somerset 189 (P.Bowler 53; P.Martin 4-29, G Chapple 4-80).
At The Oval: Essex 347 (D.Robinson 98, R.Rollins 56). Surrey 0-0.
